**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **Investigation:** Section 9 ("Warranties," p0055–p0058) contains only mutual corporate reps (organization, authority, enforceability, no conflicts) plus a Globix Agreement acknowledgement. Sections 1 and 5 impose delivery obligations (60-day launch, hosting, bandwidth) but no performance or conformance warranty. Searches for "AS IS," merchantability/implied disclaimers, workmanlike, documentation, and repair/replace/refund returned nothing — so there is no disclaimer swallowing an express warranty, but there is also no express warranty at all.
- **Classification:** Fails every fallback element, so a deviation with an insert (per detection guidance), not walk-away.
- **Cure (fallback target, one operation):** New Section 9(c) inserted after p0058 — 90-day conformance to documentation for the Site and HDI software, 30 days for the services, with HDI-option repair/replacement or refund of fees paid. Anchored to the defined "Effective Date," uses lowercase "services" because "Services" is undefined in this Agreement, and preserves the Section 10.7 survival reference to Section 9. No preferred-only extras (workmanlike standard, legal compliance, malicious code, 12-month term) were volunteered.
